text.title: Frontend Design Variant Exploration Procedure
text.summary: 9-step procedure to apply Frontend Design Variant Exploration end-to-end against a single input bundle. Each step has explicit input/action/output; gates between steps surface human-review points before binding actions.

step.name: brief
step.input: user goals + style adjectives + tech stack

step.name: brainstorm
step.action: Generate 3–5 variants, each in designs/variant-N-<slug>/, each compiling.

step.name: render-comparison
step.action: Render every variant at the target desktop and mobile widths with realistic content and stitch a side-by-side grid.
step.decision-gate: A variant that fails to render or breaks responsive is fixed or dropped here — never carried into the comparison, where it distorts the choice.

step.name: review
step.action: User reviews all against the grid; either picks one OR requests refinements (return to step 2 with notes).

step.name: refine
step.action: User-driven tweaks until ready to handoff.

step.name: extract-tokens
step.action: Extract colour, spacing, type-scale, radius and shadow values into a primitive tier, then name a semantic tier on top of it. Promote the variant-local `tokens.css` to the global config in its own commit.
step.output: token system, promoted in a reviewable commit
step.decision-gate: No production component is written before this step completes — a component authored against raw values cannot be re-themed without editing it.

step.name: storybook
step.action: Install Storybook, the framework adapter and every addon at exact pinned versions, then build stories for each component state.

step.name: component-finalize
step.action: Component agent extracts typed components into src/, each in its own directory alongside its story and its test; deletes throw-away variant code from designs/.
